microscope_info.name: microscope_parameters
microscope_info.description: Basic microscope parameters for cryoEM data collection - Dataset 10010

parameter_descriptions.dose: Electron dose per frame in e-/Å²
parameter_descriptions.particle_diameter: Estimated particle diameter in Angstroms used to auto-derive picking and reconstruction defaults
parameter_descriptions.symmetry: Default point-group symmetry for reconstruction and refinement stages (e.g., C1, D7)
parameter_descriptions.movies_path: Path to movie files (supports wildcards like *.tif)
parameter_descriptions.micrographs_path: Path to already motion-corrected micrograph files (supports wildcards like *.mrc). If provided, use import_micrographs instead of import_movies (motion correction will be skipped)
parameter_descriptions.gain_ref_path: Path to gain reference file (.mrc format)
parameter_descriptions.gain_rot: Clockwise rotation to apply to gain reference before use (units: 90° increments, values 0-3)
parameter_descriptions.gain_flip: RELION gain flip code (0 = none, 1 = flip Y, 2 = flip X). CryoSPARC flip flags are derived automatically.
